round action button

.pf-round-action
columns Upgrades ( PlatformListingActions ) and Actions ( TableListingActions , width 180, fixed right ). Both render a 3 × 2 grid of circular icon buttons.
TBC — which icon means what, and the enabled/disabled rule . Twelve circular buttons per row and the repo resolves them inside PlatformListingActions / TableListingActions , which I did not open. Sizes and grounds are measured; the glyph-to-action mapping is a guess.
